messages:
IncidentBot: URGENT: High error-rate alert for redwood-hosted-eu (eu-west-1). 5xx spike from 00:42–00:45 UTC, ~12% errors on /v1/generate, paging primary. @primary_oncall please acknowledge. :rotating_light:
Maria: acked but FYI I'm on holiday until Monday and my phone is on DND. I set an OOO and delegated to Ajay in the calendar earlier but didn't post here, my bad.
Ajay: I can pick this up — stepping in as primary now. what are we seeing?
OncallBot: Current metrics: 5xx rate 11.8%, p95 latency up 2.3s, tail token queue growth. Potential customer impact: slow or failed generations for hosted API EU. Escalation policy: if primary can't mitigate within 10m, notify secondary.
Sam: tagging in as shadow/secondary. I can join bridge if needed.
Maria: @Ajay thanks — I pushed a quick note to the calendar delegation but not to slack. If you need the quick handoff notes: 
```
- Default mitigation: scale pool + recycle worker group
- Fast rollback: pin model to previous variant (redwood-ggml-v2 -> redwood-ggml-v1)
- Config q: reduce batch_max_tokens to 256 for hot routes
- Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/hosted-eu/api-5xx-spike
```
Ajay: reading runbook now. first quick check: are autoscale events failing or is this a runtime error? can someone paste recent logs?
Lee: logs show repeated OOM-ish traces around kv-cache allocation on gpu-node-17, then worker restarts. sample log: 
```
E tensorflow: Allocator (GPU_0_bfc) ran out of memory trying to allocate 512 MiB
... worker restart triggered
```
Link to logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/streams/hosted-eu/1807654321
Sam: ok that matches prior regression after the quantization change last week. two quick mitigations: 1) lower max_sequence_len to 1024 for eu route, 2) temporarily shift traffic to dedicated fallback model in us-west until we stabilize.
Ajay: starting both: lowering max_seq on route /v1/generate eu -> config apply in progress. also initiating traffic diversion to us fallback via routing policy (10% -> 50%).
OncallBot: NOTE: apply config -> config-id 7a9f applied by Ajay at 00:47 UTC. Traffic shift job queued -> job-993.
IncidentBot: Customers with active sessions: 14 large tenants affected (partial). No full outage and no data loss reported.
Maria: sorry again for the surprise. I left the creds and short keys in the delegation doc. Ajay, you have permission to run scale actions.
Ajay: scaled worker group + reduced batch size; p95 latency improving, 5xx down to 3.4% after 4m. I'll keep traffic diversion until full green.
Sam: if it stays stable for 15m we can start a controlled rollback of the routing. I'll watch for regressions and run the heavy eval prompt-set.
Lee: filing a post-incident note and flagging the quantization roll as likely suspect.
Ajay: confirmed — marking myself primary in calendar and posting in the ops channel. tagging @Maria that I've taken ownership until Monday morning UTC.
Maria: thanks all. I'll stay reachable by DM for any credential or billing questions but otherwise OOO. please put a short incident summary in #incidents when resolved. :thumbsup: 
Sam: adding follow-up action: add auto-check in runbook to fail safe to evict largest KV allocations after quantization changes.
OncallBot: Handoff complete: primary=Ajay, secondary=Sam. Next review in 30m.
